title: homalium ceylanicum subsp. minutiflorum
intro: Homalium ceylanicum subsp. minutiflorum, commonly known as a type of flowering plant, is a subspecies of Homalium ceylanicum. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, known for its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Homalium ceylanicum subsp. minutiflorum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are believed to aid in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and hepatoprotective effects.
